blocks.text: Clickthorn compresses a release mechanism into a seedlike shell. Its smooth applicator and opening gesture belong to the made objects of everyday care; the name does not turn it into a plant or grant it protection beyond its recorded effects.
A smooth mechanical seed. Open its shell and press to discharge.
One-shot use: The violet shell splits wide to expose its applicator, which releases a bright spray. The game performs the final fade.
26 silver. Infection / Digestion severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +9; Energy +5. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 6f719cbc-bc44-4a9a-b555-7f1641e8a8d8; animation 1674b904-4454-450f-a67d-c4de1e6a0984. Reduced motion holds a still.
